newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African April tractor sales dip 15 percent yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: S.African April tractor sales dip 15 percent yr/yr.

text.p: South African tractor sales were 15.2 percent down on a year ago in April at 368 units, although in the year to date sales were 6.7 percent ahead of last year, the Agricultural Machinery Association said on Monday.
The association said the disappointing sales could reflect poor weather in February and March, causing uncertainty about summer crops, and worries about lower international maize prices.
